1cbaa7e41ee4566a29fe179cb881e453490e661f.summary: OFAC sanctioned Yin Kecheng, a Shanghai-based hacker the report says Treasury considers affiliated with China's Ministry of State Security, and Sichuan Juxinhe Network Technology, a firm believed to be directly involved with Salt Typhoon. The Treasury breach, disclosed in late December 2024, was possible after hackers exploited a BeyondTrust zero-day, and Treasury attributed the operation to Silk Typhoon (also called Hafnium). OFAC also sanctioned Integrity Tech over Flax Typhoon cyberattacks. An offer of up to $10,000,000 is made for information on hackers targeting US government or…
